localData: WebKit website data and login sessions
Restoration preference and optional saved website/page address
Saved media and native background transfer journal
Optional bounded host-level diagnostics, off on fresh installations
Current technical state in memory and explicit copy/share reports

Optional full-link testing diagnostics: page/media/resource URLs with signed queries, selected headers, cookie names/scope, public request timing/address metadata, typed browser readiness/errors; public/App Store defaults off, no automatic upload
networkDestinations: User-selected websites, source/media/library servers and their redirects; these services receive normal IP/request information and have their own practices.
developerCollectionAssessment: No automatic developer-operated collection is implemented. On-device processing is not collected data under Apple's definition. User-directed open-web navigation is distinct from developer collection. Do not claim third-party websites do not track.
supportReportAssessment: If the publisher receives reports by email or a support service, assess actual retention/use, browsing hosts, identifiers and diagnostics against Apple's optional customer-support disclosure criteria. No automatic exemption is assumed. Reevaluate App Store privacy answers when a support process is configured.
retention: Detailed diagnostics: seven sessions, 96 MB total, 32 MB/session; report coverage discloses gaps. Generated local report files replace previous owned exports. User can disable recording and delete retained history/links/reports while keeping media and website sessions.
thirdPartyHostPrivacy: Public support/privacy page hosting can log visitors' IPs independently; describe the chosen host before publication.
appStorePrivacyDraft: No developer-collected data for the current local-only app; owner must verify actual support/hosting practices, all bundled dependencies and final questionnaire before submission.
testingReportAssessment: Full signed links may grant temporary access. Known password query fields, cookie values and authorization-header values remain excluded. Active checks send additional bounded normal requests only when explicitly requested. Owner-authorized private build defaults can be enabled; persisted user opt-out wins. Turning off redacts exports; deletion removes retained details.
